svg.title: Controller box wiring (statue 0)
svg.desc: ESP32, 74AHCT125, six MAX485 transmitters and three RJ45 jacks in the controller box. Generated by tools/wiring_diagrams.py; do not edit.
svg.text: 6 over RS-485 to statues 1–3 (2 per RJ45 jack).
Legend · lines that cross without a dot are not connected
perfboard 5 V rail (fed from the PSU, see power diagram)
perfboard GND rail (same wire everywhere it appears)
RJ45 pigtail wires, T568B colours (striped = white/colour)
